How to read this diary

A pass is one recorded wheel work unit. Solid squares are hourly observations; hatched squares share a larger bucket total. Their colour shows the bucket’s average passes per hour, not an exact hourly count.

The API currently provides hourly data for 24 hours, six-hour buckets for 7 days, and noon-to-noon daily buckets for 30 days. Exact hourly history is unavailable outside the detailed feed. Dashed outlines mean no recorded observation; future hours are empty.

“Active” means a recorded interval with passes, not continuous running. Quiet hours don’t prove sleep. Activity and stretch ranges give conservative lower and upper bounds within observed, completed hours. Missing hours are excluded. The record is the longest directly observed hourly stretch; older grouped data may hide a longer one. Settlements can lag behind the wheel.
